desc.debuffByLevel: removes X ATK from a random enemy, X being the current reinforcement level
desc.forgeRoboticien: Every {n} reinforcements: crafts a random Roboticist equipment (of any rank) that joins your hand
desc.creeUnite: creates a Maintenance Unit (+2/+2 equipment) that joins your hand
desc.forgePatch: Every {n} reinforcements: creates an Engineer's Patch that joins your hand; it gives the equipped servant the power of a randomly drawn servant whose rank is at most the reinforcement level
desc.cyberPatch: applies a cybernetic patch to the rightmost servant: +X/+X, X drawn between 1 and {PATCH_MAX} (1 is six times more likely than {PATCH_MAX})
desc.balanceLeftHp: evenly shares the HP of this servant and of its left neighbor (with an odd total, the carrier keeps the extra point)
desc.dmgOwnAtk: deals its Attack to a random enemy
desc.accumulate: increases by X (reinforcement level) the damage of the next effect of this equipment
desc.releaseAccum: deals the accumulated damage to a random enemy
desc.coverFire: its ally on the right also attacks, at range (no retaliation)
desc.healSelf: heals itself {n} HP (never above its max HP)
desc.cheatDeath: the first time this servant should die, it survives with 1 HP (once per combat)
desc.trade: this servant permanently gains {h} HP and loses {n} ATK (its ATK does not go below 0)
desc.buffEnds: {bf} to the leftmost and rightmost allies
desc.plantSplashBomb: places a bomb on a random enemy. This bomb deals {n} damage to the target and to the servants next to its target
desc.dmgAllEnemiesRange: deals {a} to {n} points of damage to every enemy servant
desc.jamFirstStart: prevents the first enemy start-of-combat effect from triggering
desc.debuffRandomEnemy: removes {n} ATK from a random enemy
desc.hpRightmostTo1: reduces the HP of the rightmost enemy servant to 1
desc.companionPersists: Does not regenerate its statistics during reinforcements, dies permanently and cannot be resurrected
desc.swapStatsMostHp: swaps the life and attack of the enemy with the most hit points
desc.buffPerType: {bf} per different type in your team (max 3)
desc.buffPerTypeUncapped: {bf} per different type in your team
desc.buffPilotsPerEnemyPilot: each allied Pilot gains +{a}/+{h} for each enemy Pilot
desc.equipUnavailable: equips itself with a level {n} equipment not available during this game
desc.buffPerEnemyType: {bf} per different type among the enemies
desc.buffAdjacentPerType: the two adjacent allies permanently gain {bf} per different type in your team
desc.adaptExtra: if it survived, choose one additional Adaptation for it
desc.addUnavailableEquip: adds to your hand a level {n} equipment not available during this mission
desc.stripProvLowestHp: removes Taunt from the enemy with the fewest HP
desc.gainHighestHp: copies the HP of the character with the most HP on the board
desc.replayRattles: replays the Deathrattles already used during this combat
desc.rightmostAttacksLeftmost: the rightmost enemy attacks the leftmost enemy
desc.swapHpExtremes: the enemy with the fewest HP swaps its HP with the enemy that has the most
desc.replayFirstStart: replays the first start-of-combat effect that was triggered (other than this one)
desc.replayAdjacentStart: replays the start-of-combat effects of its direct neighbors
desc.furyAdjacentPilots: gives Fury to the adjacent allied Pilots
desc.debuffLeftmost: removes {n} ATK from the leftmost enemy
desc.stripShield: removes the Shield of an enemy, if possible
desc.swapHpLeftmost: swaps its HP with the leftmost enemy
desc.targetLowestHp: Target: the enemy with the fewest hit points
desc.healLastSurvivor: Instead of attacking, fully heals the last ally that survived an attack
desc.wildSwing: Sometimes deals double damage to the enemy next to its target, or damage to one of its neighboring allies
desc.doubleVsPilots: When it attacks, deals double damage to enemy Pilots
desc.dmgAttacker: deals it X points of damage, X being its rank
desc.preemptShot: preemptive shot at range: deals it X points of damage, X being its ATK, with no retaliation and without losing its attack turn (once per combat, on the first enemy that attacks)
desc.breakShield: Destroys the target's Shield before attacking it
desc.healLeftmost: heals {n} HP to the leftmost ally
desc.lazarus: if a drone is present when an ally (other than a drone) dies, destroys the drone and gives all its HP back to the ally in its place
desc.extractRoutines: when an allied drone dies, another random allied drone takes over its power until the end of combat
desc.swarmResonance: each time an allied drone attacks, gives +{a} ATK to the allied drones during this combat
desc.droneRanged: the drones summoned by this servant have Ranged
desc.scavenge: takes one of its pieces of equipment for the current combat
desc.discoverEquip: discovers a level {n} equipment not available during this game (choice among {PROPOSALS}, of a type absent from your team)
desc.prophecy: discovers a rank {MAX_RANK} servant; it comes into play when {PROPHECY_COST} Datacrons have been used
desc.triggerBattlecry: triggers the battlecry of the targeted ally
desc.grantRebirth: gives Rebirth to a servant until the next reinforcement
desc.genDroide: Room {n}: generates a random Droid servant (of any rank) that joins your hand
desc.droneBoostGame: gives +{a}/+{h} to all your drones, present and future, until the end of the game
desc.droneAura: allied drones have +{a}/+{h} as long as it is alive
desc.buffChosenAlly: gives +{a} ATK to an ally of your choice
desc.copyHighestAtk: copies the attack of the character with the most attack on the board
desc.buffAlliesPerIntel: gives +{a}/+{h} to all allies for each Intelligence servant on your board
desc.permAlliesStats: permanently gives +{a}/+{h} to all surviving allies, itself included
desc.grantShieldAlly: gives a Shield to a random ally
desc.firstEquipOffType: the first equipment card of each reinforcement proposal (at each Datacron spent) has a {n}% chance of being of a type unavailable during the game (copies stack)
desc.doubleLeftmostHp: doubles the HP of the leftmost character (does not stack, even with several copies)
desc.muteRiposte: the enemy servant with the most ATK cannot retaliate against the first attack it suffers
desc.pacify: the enemy servant with the most ATK cannot attack on its first chance
desc.doubleLowestHp: doubles the HP of the allied servant with the fewest HP
desc.shieldLowestHp: gives a Shield to the ally with the fewest HP
desc.buffPerSpecies: gains +{a}/+{h} for each different species among your servants
desc.discordApple: the enemy servant with the fewest HP deals its Attack damage to another random enemy
desc.firstOfferUp: the first proposal of each reinforcement contains a card of a rank above the reinforcement level (copies do not stack)
desc.droneBonus: your drones are summoned with {bf} until the end of the mission
desc.plantBombs: plants {a?a bomb|{a} bombs} dealing {n} damage on random enemies; the bomb explodes just before the first attack of the trapped servant (which then attacks if it survives)
desc.summon: summons a drone {a}/{h} {isDeathrattle!to its right|in its place}
desc.buffPilots: permanently gives {a!|+{a} ATK}{both!| and }{h!|+{h} HP} to the allied Pilots
desc.bigEquipOffer: {times?your next reinforcement will offer you|your next {times} reinforcements will offer you} {n} cards
desc.debuffAttacker: {n!removes X ATK from it, X being its rank|removes {n} ATK from it}
desc.buffPerEquip: gains +{a?|{a}}X/+{h?|{h}}X, X being the number of equipment in the team
desc.resurrect: resurrects it with its characteristics ({n?once|{n} times} per combat)
desc.gainUnavailableEquip: finds {n?an equipment|{n} equipment} of level 3 or 4 not available during this game (of a type absent from your team)
desc.gainAnyEquip: adds to your hand {n?an equipment|{n} equipment} of level 5 or 6 among all the equipment of the game (even those not available during this mission)
desc.completeFusion: for {FUSION_COST} Datacron{FUSION_COST?|s}, creates the last copy of a servant of which you have two copies, to fuse them
desc.adapt: Adaptation: at the end of combat, can improve itself by using the powers of a surviving ally
kwdesc.shield: Cancels the first source of damage
behavior.balanced.desc: Fills its board bit by bit and raises its level steadily.
behavior.horde.desc: Fills its board fast, raises its level slowly and equips little.
behavior.elite.desc: Small board of high-rank servants, reinforcement level raised very fast.
behavior.synergy.desc: Picks the cards that share the most types with its board.
